name: The oracle-taught net
hypothesis: A network trained to imitate a perfect-hindsight oracle's entries causally learns the MECHANISM of a swing rather than the price of any coin, and that mechanism generalises across pooled cryptos.
data: 15m candles, 14 pooled USDT pairs, 2017-08 to 2025-12-31 (research) + 2026 sealed
44 engineered features per bar, causal, bit-for-bit verified
mechanism: Causal TCN, 3x192 channels, 96-bar window, receptive field 15 bars, ~262k parameters. Conviction feeds a decision tree of independent modules; 9 of 33 levers are set. Long-only spot, research-only.

helped.effect: removing it collapses the held-out half to -0.1011 from +0.1572; 2025 goes to -31.2% on 21,008 trades
-0.0491 fit and -0.1395 held-out when removed, +5.6pp drawdown
the drawdown halver: without it drawdown doubles 19.1% to 38.1% and 2025 falls to -31.4%
buys the moonshots; removing either cuts 2021 from +14,554% to ~+720% but halves drawdown
reduces overfitting to long overlapping legs
honesty lever, not a performance one; found $45M orders in single 15m candles once 2021 compounded

contamination risk - a pretrained model may have seen 2026

open.what: Can the instrument find a winner at all?
open.why: three out-of-sample-approved candidates all lost the sealed year; diagnosis is underpowered, not broken

rules: A candidate needs 2-of-2 walk-forward exams before a sealed reading. One exam year is a coin flip.
Price the odds first: if the candidate's per-year ratio spread against the incumbent straddles 1.0, one sealed year cannot settle it - do not spend the reading.
'Held out' in a threshold study means held out from the THRESHOLDS, not the NET. Score net-sensitive levers on a walk-forward net.
A joint Bayesian search never measures one-lever neighbours of its own anchor - ablate separately.
Check an 'off' value against the code. max_drawdown=0.0 is the TIGHTEST brake, not the absent one.
Turnover levers fitted on the full record describe a dead market: fast rotation paid 2.97x in 2018 and 0.82x in 2024.
Run every tool from the repo root with PYTHONPATH=trading-system or the universe silently degenerates.
Compare growth multiples - ratios of (1+r) - never differences of percentages.
Trend-following gives up bull upside to avoid bear catastrophes; the +30%-every-year mandate is not reachable by this book alone.
